'''Swaystroll''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Waddledo]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Stoodbeak]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Swaystroll once dreamed of becoming a singer, but that didn't work out. Now it's non-stop drumming practice during breaks. You'll be met with an indignant glare if you file a noise complaint."

Swaystroll is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

==Evolution Trial==
Swaystroll's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Stoodbeak]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Swaystroll to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Fishing Contest (use x2000 fishing rods) or Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards).

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "Swaystroll studied Zobo Governance at Critter College. Failed out but interned at Zobo-Stomping Inc."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Swaystroll worked part-time while studying Zobo Governance at Tatari College, so the resume was full before graduation!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Even more hot-tempered, Swaystroll gets puffed up over the most trivial things. However, an orange from [[Capywata]] seems to have highly calming effects."
